title: Kissed Gooey German Cheese Fondue
description: A briny and gooey German cheese fondue dish perfect for a date night, featuring ground clove and cured ingredients, suitable for ovo-vegetarian diets.
instructions: In a fondue pot, heat the white wine over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the grated Emmental and Gruyere cheese, stirring constantly until the cheese is melted and smooth.
Add the lemon juice, ground clove, and minced garlic, stirring well to combine.
Add the sliced cornichons and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the fondue pot to a heat source at the table.
Serve the fondue with chopped fresh parsley and an assortment of dipping items, such as bread and vegetables.
Stir the fondue constantly to prevent the cheese from separating.
If the fondue becomes too thick, add a small amount of white wine to thin it out.
Cook the fondue to an internal temperature of at least 145 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure food safety.
